Splits are dated 1918/10 (the dissolution month) although several successors acted in November-December 1918 or 1919; the true dates are in each note and the neighbours' own gain events (united-principalities-of-moldavia-and-wallachia /ledger/27-28, serbs /ledger/28-29, kingdom-of-italy /ledger/15-16) are unchanged.
